visual_logic.subject_appearance: Solid black silhouette of a small, compact halisaur.
visual_logic.environment: Deep, dark indigo water with a single bright light source from above to create a stark silhouette.
visual_logic.backlight_strategy: Top-down 'God-ray' backlighting to emphasize the skull's unique proportions.
visual_logic.facial_silhouette: Characterized by an exceptionally large, circular orbital (eye socket) bulge and a shorter, blunt snout compared to other halisaurines.

pose: Tilted slightly upward toward the light source, emphasizing the oversized eye sockets which indicate its adaptation for low-light/nocturnal hunting.
negative_constraints: No internal eye detail; the eye must be represented only by the outward bulge of the skull silhouette.
